elements.text:
You are looking through your social media app and see a number of your friends have posted to their stories. As you look through their photos, you realize that a few of your close friends were all hanging out without you. 

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I text my friends and say hi.
I want to ignore them for not inviting me, but remind myself that would be childish.
I'll ask my friends to hang out later this week.
I cry and look at other pictures that I'm not in.
I want to gossip about how awful it was that I wasn't invited, but decide that would not be nice.
